name: Syurna
summary: In Darnassus, Syurna trains night elf rogues in the Cenarion Enclave. She guides aspiring scouts, spies, and covert operatives, then sends new rogues on trials of stealth and cunning.

sections.title: A Scout Among the Grove
sections.body: Syurna trains those who move unseen through Darnassus. In the Cenarion Enclave, she teaches rogues evasion, lockpicking, and lethal strikes. The Sentinels display the Kaldorei’s martial strength, while the Sisterhood of Elune holds its spiritual wisdom. The Kaldorei also depend on shadows and stealth, and Syurna sharpens the eyes and blades that guard Teldrassil.

sections.title: Tests of Cunning
sections.body: Syurna tests young operatives beyond the lessons taught in the enclave. She sends promising initiates into deeper fieldwork to see whether they have the instincts to survive beyond the World Tree’s boughs and serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.

faq.answer: Syurna trains night elf rogues in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. She teaches combat skills and guides rogues serving the Alliance.

faq.q: Where exactly can I find Syurna in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Find Syurna in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, among the trees and pavilions beside other mentors of the shadows.

faq.q: Why is a rogue trainer in the Cenarion Enclave?
aliases: why is rogue trainer in enclave
faq.answer: The Cenarion Enclave is known chiefly for druidism and nature, but night elf scouts and covert pathfinders train along its wooded edges, away from the public pageantry of the Temple of Elune and the Warrior's Terrace.
Syurna guides novice operatives who have proven themselves in Shadowglen as they hone their talents in the wider world, including through Destiny Calls.

angles.text: As a night elf rogue, you can learn stealth, poison, and martial precision from Syurna, one of Darnassus’s principal instructors.
As a night elf, you share the Kaldorei scouts’ quiet tradition of protecting woodland sanctuaries from the shadows instead of open battle.
